semantic_candidate.type_signature: (goal: set<ground-positive-atom>, operator: (pre, add, delete) sets<ground-positive-atom>)-> either impossible or set<ground-positive-atom>
semantic_candidate.scope: Closed finite propositional ground STRIPS, positive preconditions and positive conjunctive goals, ADD and DEL disjoint; atomic symbols only, no free variables, quantifiers, negation, conditional effects or implicit source-world knowledge.
semantic_candidate.law: Given action a=(Pre,Add,Del) and desired G, after-action state is (S\Del)∪Add iff Pre⊆S. Regression is undefined/impossible if (G\Add)∩Del≠∅, otherwise Reg(G,a)=Pre∪(G\Add). For ALL ground states S: (Pre⊆S and G⊆Result(S,a)) iff Reg exists and Reg⊆S. Distinguish search usefulness Add∩G≠∅ from logical regression: usefulness is NOT required for the equivalence.
positive_witnesses: Pre={charged}, Add={observed}, Del={old}, Goal={observed,safe}: Reg={charged,safe}; starting at {charged,old,safe} ends {charged,observed,safe}.
Goal={observed}, same action: Reg={charged}, as observed is supplied by ADD.
Goal={safe}, same action: Reg={charged,safe}; action need not add any goal to be logically safe.
Goal={at_c}, action at_b→at_c regresses to {at_b}; predecessor action at_a→at_b regresses to {at_a}.
falsifiers: Ignore DEL list: if goal={safe} but DEL={safe} and no ADD safe, regression MUST be impossible.
Test action relevance as if necessary for logical weakest precondition: would reject a sound unchanged-goal action.
Ignore Pre in regression: a goal satisfied after an inapplicable action is not justified.
Allow non-ground atoms or negative/disjunctive goals and claim the exact same positive-only formula is a complete general planner.
